_comment: STAC V1 smoke-run baseline, regenerated after the audit fixed the dead spiking
pathway. Before that fix the AdEx neurons never reached threshold: spike_mean was
exactly 0.0, train_l1 exactly 0.0, and the surrogate gradient underflowed to zero,
so the logits were identical at every sequence position. Any V1 numbers recorded
before that predate a functioning model.
tests/test_v1_baseline.py asserts current runs stay close to these values.
notes: Random-weight model: these pin behaviour (spiking is alive, loss is finite), not language quality.
